per_key_checks.assessment: The added `many` arm is grammatical, idiomatic and CLDR-correct. It is the `other` arm with the partitive inserted: `many == other.replace('d’','',1)` proved byte-identical otherwise, so the two arms cannot drift in voice, pronoun or second sentence. `de` + vowel elides to `d’` (U+2019) before `agents`, and `de` is obligatory after a bare million (read `1 000 000` as `un million de`), so the only diversion the arm causes is exactly the case it exists for. Verb and adjective agree with the complement (sont prêts / installés), as French does with a collective numeral; `les` resumes agents. Placement before `other` is correct and matches the namespace's four existing many-bearing keys. Terminology: agent intégré matches the sibling key dismiss_offer ('d’agents intégrés'); installer/installés and modifier match the corpus renderings. Register: vous, sentence case, no Veuillez. Typography: U+2019 apostrophes only, no ASCII apostrophe, em dash with ASCII spaces identical to the 8 pre-existing arms, no NBSP/NNBSP/bidi/zero-width, NFC.
